simple.meaning: מוֹלָדָה (Môwlâdâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “Moladah , a place in Palestine.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מוֹלָדָה (H4137) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Joshua 15:26, with occurrences in Joshua, 1 Chronicles, Nehemiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מוֹלָדָה (H4137) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מוֹלָדָה (H4137) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מוֹלָדָה (Môwlâdâh) / H4137 is traced through Joshua 15:26, Joshua 19:2, 1 Chronicles 4:28, Nehemiah 11:26 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
